message: プリンセスくるせいだーす

name: Sally
message: 「Prez. I'm hungry~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sally. There's something I've been wondering about for a while」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm? If I answer it, will you make me some food?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, you've got a deal」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Your room is right above mine, isn't it」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「But the room upstairs is still vacant. Which means you're living between the first and second floors, right」

name: Sally
message: 「Yup, that's right」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think the space between them is tall enough for a person to actually live in」

name: Sally
message: 「I'd love to say it's narrow enough for a demon to live in--buuut, buzz! Wrong answer」

name: Synn
message: 「Then is there some kind of trick to it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. I'm using a spatial distortion device I bought from a Demon World goods shop」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh~~. Is that so」
Still, that's one shady piece of merchandise.

name: Synn
message: 「Mind letting me take a quick peek inside?」

name: Sally
message: 「Too bad, no prize for you. This device has a magic lock on it. So if it doesn't detect demonic power, you can't even pass through」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
Hold on? In that case, since I'm the Demon Lord, does that mean I can get in?

name: Synn
message: 「Mind if I try stepping inside for a bit?」

name: Sally
message: 「I just told you it's impossible~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, it's fine, it's fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, cut it out. Who knows what's gonna happen?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the landlord here, so I ought to at least keep proper track of things like this」

name: Sally
message: 「Sheesh, there's no helping it. Well then, Prez. One quick hop straight to my room♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, it's pitch black!」

name: Sally
message: 「H-Huh... Something's wrong with the device...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sally
message: 「I-It's reacting to magical power!?」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Could it be...」

name: Sally
message: 「W-W-Whoa!! It's starting to go haywire!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!!」

name: Sally
message: 「I-It's sending us flying somewhere!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaaaaaah」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Where on earth are we...」

name: Woman
message: 「--I have been awaiting your arrival.」
I am greeted by a crisp, dignified voice. Slowly, I shift my gaze.
With a composed demeanor, a woman stares at me--no, at Sally.
She has distinctly intelligent features, brimming with unmistakable confidence.

name: Meivisu
message: 「My name is Meivisu. I have long awaited your coming.」

name: Meivisu
message: 「Indeed. Our lost hope, who shall guide us.」

name: Meivisu
message: 「The Lost Princess.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Prez. What's a 'pwincess'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't that mean a royal princess...?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh!! So that means I'm a princess? Class chaaange from Demon World idol to princess!!」

name: Meivisu
message: 「Hmm... Karen is not here... What is the meaning of this?」

name: Meivisu
message: 「Moreover, why are there two of them... Yet, I sense magical power from both.」

name: Sally
message: 「It's true!! Magic is overflowing from Kaicho!! That means you're not human either, Kaicho!!」

name: Meivisu
message: 「C-Could it be... two princesses... Are you saying two Dark Princesses have survived!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Pffft, they say you're a princess too, Kaicho!!」

name: Meivisu
message: 「So you are called Kaicho」

name: Synn
message: 「N―No. Actually―」

name: Ririan
message: 「Senpai! This is a pleasant miscalculation!! Even Ririan is surprised!!」

name: Meivisu
message: 「Ririan. Are these the princesses you spoke of?」

name: Ririan
message: 「Hmmmm. I think they were, or maybe they weren't...」

name: Ririan
message: 「I'm pretty sure they were called 'Iincho,' and 'Kaicho' sounds like a higher rank, so they're probably relatives...」

name: Ririan
message: 「Yes! There's no mistake, it's definitely them!!」

name: Chocolier
message: 「As expected of the boss!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? Hold on!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Things are starting to get interesting」

name: Meivisu
message: 「I see」

name: Meivisu
message: 「I want you to save this... Witch World together with us」
And so, for some reason, Sally-chan and I ended up having to save this world--the Witch World--as the twin Dark Princesses.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... I'm actually a guy, though...」

name: Meivisu
message: 「Do you intend to mock me? There is no way someone who isn't a witch could wield magic」

name: Ririan
message: 「Besides, no matter how you look at it, aren't you a cute girl♪」
My ordeal has only just begun... *sigh*.
